Regulation: B.C. Reg. 101/2026
Made under: Environmental Management Act
Published in: No. 12 – B.C. Regs. 99 to 109, June 30, 2026
Deposit date: June 19, 2026

B.C. Reg. 101/2026, deposited June 19, 2026, under theENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT ACT[sections 134 and 138 (2) and (3)]. Order in Council 253/2026, approved and ordered June 19, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that, effective July 1, 2026, the Hazardous Waste Regulation, B.C. Reg. 63/88, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — T. DAVIDSON,Minister of Environment and Parks; D. GIBSON,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 45 of the Hazardous Waste Regulation, B.C. Reg. 63/88, is amended (a)	by repealing subsection (3) and substituting the following: (3)	Every applicant for a licence under this section must (a)	complete the application in Form 2 of Schedule 5, and (b)	submit the application, accompanied by an application fee in the amount of $500, to the director., (b)	in subsection (4) by adding "and on receipt of the fee referred to in that subsection," after "in subsection (3),", and (c)	by adding the following subsection: (4.1)	Every holder of a transport licence must pay an annual licence fee of $200 no later than 30 days after each anniversary of the date on which the licence was first issued. minutes_briefs.title: BC hazardous waste transport licence fees: $500 application, $200 annual fee
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has changed the fees for hazardous waste transport licences under the Hazardous Waste Regulation. Starting July 1, 2026, anyone applying for a new licence must pay a $500 application fee. Licence holders must also pay an annual fee of $200, due within 30 days after each anniversary of when the licence was first issued. This applies to businesses that transport hazardous waste in BC.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you hold or plan to apply for a hazardous waste transport licence in BC, budget for the $500 application fee and the $200 annual renewal fee.

key_dates.label: BC hazardous waste transport licence new fees take effect
